name: Nitrogen source interface
generic_type: Boundary item: supplier-owned nitrogen source (cylinder bundle, trailer or facility header; not selected)
function_and_rationale: Defines the upstream boundary. Source pressure range, temperature and depletion are unresolved (UI-02); IL-02 (20 MPa(g)) is used only to exercise the calculations.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Source isolation valve, block 1
generic_type: Manual isolation valve, normally open in service (type TBD)
function_and_rationale: First block of a double-block arrangement at the source boundary. With HV-302 and the bleed HV-303 it lets the system be isolated and the pressure between the blocks vented before work (precedent: NASA-STD-5005D 5.2.6(b), two valves in series with a vent between, for GN2 into ECS ducting).
design_basis: UI-06 design pressure unresolved; shown fully open in the budget
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Second isolation valve, block 2
generic_type: Manual isolation valve, normally open in service (type TBD)
function_and_rationale: Second block of the double-block arrangement; separates the pressure-control section from the source so that block 1 can be proved by venting between the blocks.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Block-to-block bleed valve
generic_type: Manual valve, normally closed; discharges through RO-301 to VH-301 (type TBD)
function_and_rationale: Vents the volume between HV-301 and HV-302 (proves block 1), and with HV-302 open and HV-301 closed vents the high-pressure section as far as PCV-301 for controlled depressurization.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Bleed restrictor
generic_type: Fixed flow restriction in the bleed manifold (size TBD)
function_and_rationale: Limits the depressurization rate so that vent flow, noise, cold gas and static charge stay manageable. Size is not set: it needs the volumes, the target time and the vent design (UI-11).
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: High-pressure particulate filter
generic_type: Filter housing with removable element and differential-pressure taps (grade TBD)
function_and_rationale: Protects the regulator seats, flow element and downstream user from particles shed by the source and the piping. PDT-301 indicates loading.
design_basis: Allocation AS-04 fraction of local absolute pressure; UI-09
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Stage-1 pressure regulator
generic_type: Pressure-reducing regulator, high-pressure to intermediate (type, trim and ratings TBD)
function_and_rationale: First reduction from the source pressure to the intermediate set pressure (IL-03). Staged reduction limits the pressure ratio and cooling per stage and the effect of source depletion on the delivery pressure; a regulator is NOT overpressure protection.
design_basis: IL-02; IL-03; UI-08 regulator data unresolved
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Stage-1 outlet relief device
generic_type: Pressure relief device on the intermediate zone (set pressure, capacity and type TBD)
function_and_rationale: Protects the intermediate zone and everything downstream if PCV-301 fails open. Capacity must cover the failed-open regulator at full source pressure (UI-07). Set pressure and sizing are NOT given.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Intermediate-zone bleed valve
generic_type: Manual valve, normally closed; discharges through RO-301 to VH-301 (type TBD)
function_and_rationale: Vents the gas trapped between the two regulators, which cannot drain backwards through either regulator once the section upstream is vented.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Stage-2 pressure regulator
generic_type: Pressure-reducing regulator, intermediate to delivery (type, trim and ratings TBD)
function_and_rationale: Second reduction to the delivery set pressure (IL-04). Receives cold gas from stage 1 (see regulator_envelope.csv). Capacity falls as the stage-2 inlet pressure falls.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Delivery-zone relief device
generic_type: Pressure relief device on the delivery zone (set pressure, capacity and type TBD)
function_and_rationale: Protects the delivery zone and the downstream user boundary if PCV-302 fails open, including the case where stage 1 has also failed open (full source pressure at the stage-2 inlet). Set pressure and sizing are NOT given.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Flow element
generic_type: Flow measurement element, mass-flow compensated (principle TBD)
function_and_rationale: Measures delivered mass flow for FIC-301. Measurement principle, range and loss are not selected; a pressure-drop allocation is used (AS-04).
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Downstream flow control valve
generic_type: Control valve (type, trim, failure position TBD)
function_and_rationale: Sets the delivered flow under FIC-301. Its pressure drop depends on the unresolved downstream limits (UI-01, UI-04), so it is carried as an unresolved row in the budget. Failure position on loss of power or air is UI-13.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Conditional check valve
generic_type: Check valve at the delivery interface (type and cracking pressure TBD); CONDITIONAL
function_and_rationale: Justified only if backflow from the downstream user into the pressure-control section is a credible hazard (for example the downstream side can be pressurized or contaminated while supply is lost). It is not an isolation valve (it leaks) and its cracking pressure is vendor data. Shown dashed on the P&ID.
design_basis: UI-09; backflow credibility is an open decision (HAZ-HP-09)
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned
source_refs: NASA-STD-5005D 5.2.1.2 (precedent for a check valve downstream of a shut-off valve at a hazardous interface)

name: Remote shutoff valve
generic_type: Remotely actuated shutoff valve (actuator and failure position TBD)
function_and_rationale: Automatic and remote isolation of the delivery interface on a trip from ES-301 (PSHH-301) or a manual emergency command. Failure position on loss of power or air is UI-13 and must be decided against the downstream hazards.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Delivery block valve
generic_type: Manual isolation valve at the delivery interface (type TBD)
function_and_rationale: Local manual isolation of the delivery interface; used with HV-305 to prove isolation before work on the downstream connection.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Delivery-zone bleed valve
generic_type: Manual valve, normally closed; discharges through RO-301 to VH-301 (type TBD)
function_and_rationale: Vents the delivery zone between XV-301 and HV-304 when the delivery interface is isolated.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Test and calibration connection
generic_type: Capped test connection with isolation (type TBD)
function_and_rationale: Leak-check, pressure-test and gauge-calibration access on the delivery zone, kept off the process path so that maintenance does not need the line opened.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Delivery interface to downstream user
generic_type: Boundary item: connection to the downstream user (not designed here)
function_and_rationale: Downstream system boundary. The downstream pressure, flow and temperature limits are unresolved (UI-01, UI-03, UI-04).
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Vent header
generic_type: Vent header collecting bleed and relief discharge (size TBD)
function_and_rationale: Collects discharge from PSV-301, PSV-302 and the bleed manifold and routes it to VS-301. Back-pressure during relief is unresolved (UI-07, UI-11) and must be checked against relief-device limits.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Vent stack (discharge)
generic_type: Vent stack / discharge point to a safe location (location, height, silencing TBD)
function_and_rationale: Final discharge boundary. Must discharge where exposure of people, ignition-free but oxygen-displacing nitrogen, noise and air intakes are acceptable. Location is unresolved (UI-11, UI-12).
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Area ventilation
generic_type: Boundary item: room or enclosure ventilation (not designed here)
function_and_rationale: Dilutes leaks and small releases in an enclosed area and supports oxygen monitoring. Room volume and ventilation rate are unresolved (UI-12).
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned
source_refs: NASA-STD-5005D 5.2.6(c) (oxygen monitoring where GN2 meets an enclosed duct system)

name: Control and data acquisition
generic_type: Boundary item: control and data-acquisition system
function_and_rationale: Indication, alarms and the flow loop FIC-301. Safety trips are in ES-301, independent of the flow loop.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Independent trip and interlock logic
generic_type: Boundary item: trip logic independent of CS-301 (concept)
function_and_rationale: Closes XV-301 on a high-high pressure trip (PSHH-301) and on manual emergency command. A trip does NOT replace a relief device.
design_basis: UI-13; performance level and architecture unresolved
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned
source_refs: NASA-STD-8719.17D 4.10.1.10 (regulators and similar devices are not overpressure protection)

name: LN2 source vessel interface
generic_type: Boundary item: liquid nitrogen storage vessel with its own relief, vent and level systems (not selected)
function_and_rationale: Upstream boundary. Capacity, pressure, withdrawal pressure-building and relief are unresolved (UI-20). Properties are read at 0 MPa(g) boiling for the calculations only.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Source liquid withdrawal valve
generic_type: Manual cryogenic-service isolation valve (type, extended bonnet and ratings TBD)
function_and_rationale: Isolates the transfer system from the vessel. Closing it with liquid on its downstream side traps liquid between HV-401 and XV-401; TRV-401 protects that section.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Thermal relief, HV-401 to XV-401 section
generic_type: Small thermal relief device discharging to VH-401 (set pressure, capacity and type TBD)
function_and_rationale: Protects the liquid-capable section between HV-401 and XV-401 against trapped-liquid expansion. Set pressure and capacity are not given (UI-22).
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Remote isolation valve
generic_type: Remotely actuated cryogenic-service isolation valve (actuator, failure position TBD)
function_and_rationale: Starts and stops the transfer and closes on a trip from ES-401. Failure position is unresolved (UI-13). Closing it traps liquid in the line unless the line vent path is open.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Vacuum-jacketed transfer line assembly
generic_type: Inner line, vacuum jacket, multilayer insulation, supports and spacers (vendor system; not selected)
function_and_rationale: Carries liquid nitrogen with low heat ingress. Heat leak depends on vacuum level, MLI and supports (cryogenic_heat_leak.csv); loss of vacuum raises heat leak by about two orders of magnitude in the screening model.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Contraction bellows or flexible joint
generic_type: Axial movement device inside the vacuum jacket (type and travel TBD)
function_and_rationale: Absorbs the inner-line contraction relative to the warm jacket on cooldown. Required travel follows from thermal_contraction.csv and the real run length (UI-21, UI-24); movement capacity is vendor data.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Line supports and guides
generic_type: Support, guide and anchor system for the line (design TBD)
function_and_rationale: Carries the line while allowing the contraction movement; anchors must not restrain the line axially unless a movement device is designed in (restrained 304 stainless stress bound is in thermal_contraction.csv). Supports are also a heat-leak path (AS-14).
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Jacket annulus relief device
generic_type: Pressure relief device on the vacuum annulus (set pressure, type and capacity TBD)
function_and_rationale: Protects the vacuum jacket if the inner line leaks cold fluid into the annulus. Without it the jacket can over-pressurize. Sizing needs the credible leak size (UI-22).
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Thermal relief, transfer line section
generic_type: Small thermal relief device discharging to VH-401 (set pressure, capacity and type TBD)
function_and_rationale: Protects the inner line when XV-401 and the receiver-end valves are closed with liquid inside. Set pressure and capacity are not given (UI-22).
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Phase separator and cooldown vent pot
generic_type: Vapour-liquid separation vessel at the receiving end (design TBD)
function_and_rationale: Takes the two-phase flow of the cooldown, sends vapour to VH-401 and liquid to the receiver once flow is single-phase. Sizing needs the two-phase data (UI-27, UI-29, UI-33).
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Phase-separator vent valve
generic_type: Cryogenic-service vent valve, normally open in warm and cooldown states (type TBD)
function_and_rationale: Keeps a vent path open so that no liquid-capable section is isolated at both ends. Opens the vapour path from PS-401 to VH-401.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Receiver isolation valve
generic_type: Manual cryogenic-service isolation valve at the receiver (type TBD)
function_and_rationale: Isolates the receiver from the transfer line. Closing it with liquid upstream traps liquid between XV-401 and HV-402; TRV-402 protects that section.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Receiver interface
generic_type: Boundary item: receiving vessel or user (not designed here)
function_and_rationale: Downstream boundary. Capacity, fill rate and back-pressure are unresolved (UI-26).
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Dry nitrogen purge supply interface
generic_type: Boundary item: dry GN2 purge source (not designed here)
function_and_rationale: Supplies dry nitrogen for purge before cooldown and warm-up. Its source and pressure are unresolved; if taken from the high-pressure system at DI-301 it needs its own further pressure reduction and relief.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Purge isolation valve
generic_type: Manual isolation valve (type TBD)
function_and_rationale: Isolates the purge supply from the transfer line.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Purge check valve
generic_type: Check valve preventing liquid backflow into the purge line (type TBD)
function_and_rationale: Justified here: during cooldown and transfer the line is at cryogenic temperature and liquid could otherwise enter the purge line, which would trap liquid and freeze the supply connection.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Cold vent header
generic_type: Vent header for cold vapour and relief discharge (size and material TBD)
function_and_rationale: Collects discharge from PS-401, TRV-401, TRV-402, PSV-401 and the source vessel vent interface and routes it to VS-401. Must be material-suitable for cold vapour and sized for the relief flows (UI-22, UI-29).
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Cold vent stack (discharge)
generic_type: Vent stack to a safe location (location, height, dispersion TBD)
function_and_rationale: Final discharge boundary. Cold nitrogen vapour is denser than air until it warms, so it can drift to low ground and displace oxygen (UI-29). Location is unresolved.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Area ventilation
generic_type: Boundary item: room or enclosure ventilation (not designed here)
function_and_rationale: Dilutes leaks and boil-off in an enclosed area. Needs room volume and ventilation rate (UI-12).
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Control and data acquisition
generic_type: Boundary item: control and data-acquisition system
function_and_rationale: Indication, alarms and sequence supervision of the cooldown and transfer states.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned

name: Independent trip and interlock logic
generic_type: Boundary item: trip logic independent of CS-401 (concept)
function_and_rationale: Closes XV-401 on a high-high receiver-end pressure trip (PSHH-401) or manual emergency command. A trip does NOT replace relief devices.
rating_and_model: Not selected; no model, rating or size assigned
